'''Kua-nsi''' (''{{IPA|kʰua33 n̩21 sɨ55}}''; {{lang-zh|跨恩斯话}}; Hedong Yi 河东彝) is a [[Loloish language]] of [[Heqing County]], [[Yunnan]], China.

'''Gomotage''' (''{{IPA|ɣɔ21 mɔ33 ta55 ɣə21}}''), an undocumented and little-known Loloish language of [[Eryuan County]], is also probably related to Kua-nsi (Yang 2010:7).<ref>Yang, Cathryn. 2010. ''Lalo regional varieties: Phylogeny, dialectometry, and sociolinguistics''. Melbourne: La Trobe University PhD dissertation. http://arrow.latrobe.edu.au:8080/vital/access/HandleResolver/1959.9/153015 {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211114052407/http://arrow.latrobe.edu.au:8080/vital/access/manager/Repository/latrobe:33403;jsessionid=649494DF11A1A3B5EC8CE218F3CBA1B9 |date=2021-11-14 }}.</ref>

==Distribution==
The Kua-nsi live in the following villages of Liuhe Township 六合乡, northern Heqing County (Castro, et al. 2010:23).<ref>Andy Castro, Brian Crook, Royce Flaming. 2010. ''[http://www.sil.org/silesr/2010/silesr2010-001_English.pdf A sociolinguistic survey of Kua-nsi and related Yi varieties in Heqing county, Yunnan province, China]''. SIL International.</ref>
